errorCodes.meaning: The document's proven issuer is not a configured source of this replica.
`logContent` does not verify as a did:webvh log establishing `didId` — a broken hash chain, a bad proof, a pre-rotation violation, or an entry count that is not `versionCount`.

`logContent` does not strictly extend the log the replica holds for the slot, or falls below the replica's high-water mark for the DID: it rewrites or truncates history the replica has already served.
The replica holds the DID as deactivated; a deactivated DID takes no further entries.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.

status.description: `applied` — the replica now holds and serves exactly the submitted state. `unchanged` — it already held that state (or a newer version with identical content), and nothing was written.

schema.description: The same shape as webvh/_shared/0.1 SyncUpdate (the element of webvh/sync/batch/0.1), inlined because a top-level $ref payload does not survive every binding generator. The two MUST stay identical.

didId.description: The DID the log establishes. A replica MUST refuse a log that does not establish exactly this DID.

disabled.description: Whether the source has disabled the slot. A replica MUST stop serving a disabled slot and MUST resume only on an update carrying `false`.

logContent.description: The slot's complete did.jsonl — one log entry per line — not a delta.

mnemonic.description: The slot path on its hosting domain (e.g. `alice`, `people/alice`, or `.well-known` for a root DID).

versionCount.description: Number of entries in `logContent`, as the source counts them. A replica MUST refuse an update whose `logContent` does not contain exactly this many entries.

witnessContent.description: The slot's did-witness.json. ABSENT means the slot holds no witness proofs: the replica MUST drop any witness proofs it holds for the slot. Absence never means "unchanged".
